notes.title: Available Now!!!
notes.content:
The spiritual successor to Super Puzzle Platformer Deluxe has finally been released!

Unidentified Falling Objects is a new game from the same developer and musician. This time with online multiplayer, up to 21 players at once. All new levels, challenges, and obstacles. Customizable player loadouts and lots of equipment and powerups to unlock.

Get it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2087610

notes.title: New Content! Weeklong Deal! Holy Crap!
notes.content:
Hi SPPDX Fans:

We launched an update today that includes a new outfit (Astronaut), a new level (Sadistic Satellite), plus a host of other goodies. More challenges, new achievements, and some secret surprises.

To celebrate, Super Puzzle Platformer Deluxe is on sale for 50% off ($3.99) as part of Steam's Weeklong Deals. Buy a copy for a friend and show them how much you care!

We're also smoothing out the edges on a Mac version, which will be out very soon. Just FYI.

Hope you enjoy the new content and let us know what you think on the Steam forums. Thanks for playing!

Adult Swim Games

notes.title: Fist Puncher Content Update and 50% Off Sale
notes.content:

notes.title: Now Available - Super Puzzle Platformer Deluxe
notes.content:
Super Puzzle Platformer Deluxe is Now Available on Steam and is 25% off

Take one part falling block puzzle game, combine one part old-school platformer, add a couple thousand pixels, blend and serve. Why match colored blocks when you can just shoot the hell out of them? Play single player or local head-to-head multi-player and try to survive as long as you can across 6 different game worlds.

*Offer ends May 31st at 10AM Pacific Time
